title: INDIA bloc schedules rally in Bhopal against Election Commission roll revision
seoTitle: Bhopal rally against SIR roll revision

tea.why: Opposition parties allege that Special Intensive Revision deleted over 13 crore names from electoral rolls, calling it vote theft.
tea.want: They demand the protection of voting rights, scrapping of the SIR exercise, and constitutional safeguards.
tea.changed: Nov 28: Madhya Pradesh Congress submitted a memorandum to police requesting access to Lal Parade Ground for the December 12 march.

summary: The INDIA opposition alliance and the Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee scheduled a protest march and rally in Bhopal for December 12, 2026, as part of their nationwide Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao campaign. Leaders including Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, Akhilesh Yadav, and Mamata Banerjee are scheduled to participate. Organisers expect between 100,000 and 150,000 attendees. Protesters are raising concerns over the Election Commission Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, alleging improper deletion of voter names. The planned march will start at the Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar statue and proceed to Lal Parade Ground. Congress representatives met local police officials to seek venue permissions and logistics access.
demands: Scrap the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise
response: A Congress delegation met Additional Commissioner of Police Monika Shukla to request venue permission. Police indicated that the approval process requires coordination with the traffic department and the Seventh Battalion.

crowd.text: between one lakh and 1.5 lakh people, according to the Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee

updates.text: The INDIA bloc announced plans for anti-SIR rallies in Bhopal, Ahmedabad, and Kolkata.
Congress leaders submitted a memorandum to Bhopal police seeking permission for the Lal Parade Ground venue for a December 12 rally.
